Actor Rahul Roy Recounts Difficulties After Brain Stroke

Actor Rahul Roy has spoken about the challenges he faced after suffering a brain stroke. He expressed his uncertainty about regaining his ability to walk. Roy described the difficult period following the stroke, during which he struggled with basic functions like speaking and walking.
